inputs.text: [excited][playful] And here we are at [serious] paleontology! [happily] How do we know all this? [curious] Thanks to scientists who dig in the ground.
[curious][playful] Paleontologists. [excited] They find bones, teeth, footprints, eggs. [softly] They clean them with a toothbrush, very, very gently.
[excited] They put hundreds of bones back together, [quickly] like a giant puzzle! [happily] They figure out how it walked and what it ate.
[playful][chuckles] Almost everything! [softly] But not the colors. [serious] Nobody knows. [happily] So artists make them up.
[excited][playful] Maybe! [gasps] Or covered in feathers: one giant carnivorous chicken! [happily] Was Triceratops blue? Pink? [playful] Spotted yellow? [amazed] You get to imagine it!
[chuckles] Orange. Perfect. [softly] We don't know everything. [happily] But we know that life has been one huge adventure, [amazed] from the very first bacteria all the way to today's birds.
[happily][excited] Anytime you want. [playful] The journey's always here, ready and waiting.
